title: Wolfpack Charters Fishing
specs: Trips accommodate 1–4 guests depending on the trip
includes: All fishing gear and bait included
blurb: Guests choose from several fishing trips that include gear, bait, and guided fishing experiences. Trips vary in duration and target species, suitable for small groups or families. The operator provides all fishing gear; guests bring personal essentials.
groupInfo: Trips accommodate 1–4 guests depending on the trip
bring: Sunscreen & sunglasses (reef-safe SPF 50+ and polarized shades)
Water & drinks (bring a cooler with preferred beverages)
Snacks & lunch (easy-to-eat food, no glass containers)
Layers & rain gear (light jacket or windbreaker)
Motion sickness medication (Dramamine or Bonine 30–60 minutes before departure)
Camera or phone (waterproof case or lanyard recommended)
